note: lex_config reads the single-quote character at input offset 32765, the start of the trailing ''' delimiter near the end of the 32768-byte fuzz buffer.
The next two bytes are also single quotes, so lex_config dispatches to lex_multiline_string with lexer->pos pointing at the last two bytes of the global static_data buffer.
peek returns a single quote, so end is set to the three-byte delimiter "'''" used by the subsequent strncmp.
advance_n moves lexer->pos forward by 2 bytes to offset 32768, which is one past the end of the 32768-byte static_data global buffer.
strncmp reads 3 bytes starting at lexer->pos (offset 32768), which is past the end of the global static_data buffer, causing a global-buffer-overflow READ of 3 bytes.
The out-of-bounds read of 3 bytes past the global buffer is the ASAN-detected crash (Global-buffer-overflow READ 3).
